_comment: Cheap gates for Stage A (harvest.py) ONLY. The real judging — seatbelts, bed layout, damp risk, value vs market — lives in research-prompt.md, because it needs the detail page and the web, not a regex. Seven params used to sit here doing nothing at all (min_sleeping, requires_bathroom, max_km, vehicle_type, location, reference_models); they were never wired into the scraper and are now enforced by the rubric instead.
